_help: Photo albums and YouTube videos for the 'Photos & Videos' page. To add an album, copy one { ... } block inside "albums" and change it. Upload photos to assets/images/originals/<album-folder>/ and put that path in "src". Every photo needs "alt" text (a short description for people who can't see it). For videos, paste ANY YouTube link into "url". "featuredVideo" is shown on the Home page. THIS FILE CURRENTLY CONTAINS TEST DATA - replace before launch.
